description: AIRPORT_POINT is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. Airport Point. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category City Government. Its tags are doitt gis, airport point, doittgis. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transit Authority (MTA). The portal shows 2014-11-18 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
